title: Explorer skill field-log entry
description: One line of a project's private field log (default .explorer_field_log.jsonl, gitignored or in a private repo). Append one entry whenever the cluster or the harness disagrees with or adds to the skill. Evidence and project_tag stay private; only a sanitized, generalized lesson ever reaches the public skill (references/evolution.md).

date.description: From a date call, never an estimate: YYYY-MM-DD, optionally with a time and offset.

project_tag.description: Free text naming the project or session. Private: never copied into the skill.

category.description: skill-error = an instruction or snippet in the skill was wrong; triage = a failure no triage row matched; harness = a tool behaved differently from the harness assumptions table.

observation.description: What happened, in one or two plain sentences.

evidence.description: Where it shows: job id and sacct line, log line, NODE_DRIVER line, tool schema text. Private.

confirmation.description: observed = seen in a real run; probed = a deliberate test or probe job; inferred = reasoning, not yet tested.

generalizes.description: True if it would hold for other users or projects on the cluster, not only this one.

skill_ref.description: The skill file and section it concerns, if any, e.g. references/cluster-setup.md section 3.

proposed_change.description: Optional suggested wording or fix for the skill.
